doc.brief: The QBoxLayout class lines up child widgets horizontally or vertically.
doc.index_brief: Lines up child widgets horizontally or vertically

QBoxLayout::Direction direction() const.brief: Returns the direction of the box.

bool setStretchFactor(QLayout *layout, i.brief: Sets the stretch factor for the layout *layout* to *stretch* and returns `true` if *layout* is found in this layout (not including child layouts); otherwise returns `false`.

void addStretch(int stretch).brief: Adds a stretchable space (a [QSpacerItem](xref:qt:QSpacerItem)) with zero minimum size and stretch factor *stretch* to the end of this box layout.

void addWidget(QWidget *widget, int stre.brief: Adds *widget* to the end of this box layout, with a stretch factor of *stretch* and alignment *alignment*.
